summary: Former fire lookout site on Wallace Peak, Bath County, VA, in the George Washington National Forest; listed as gone; concrete bases remain on the summit.

facts.status_note: Tower gone; a hiking guide says only the concrete bases remain at the summit

access.note: Reached on foot by a steep, remote hike on the Marshall Draft Trail; the old tower road is no longer used

visit.trail_note: Marshall Draft Trail route; limited summit views because of tree growth

evidence.supports: filed under the George Washington National Forest
listed under Bath and Augusta counties
summit was once the site of a fire lookout tower
evidence.quote: The summit of Wallace Peak was once the site of a fire lookout tower

evidence.supports: concrete bases remain at the summit; rest of tower long gone
evidence.quote: The concrete bases for the tower are still at the summit, but the rest of the tower is long gone.

evidence.supports: challenging, remote hike with a steep ascent
evidence.quote: a challenging, remote hike featuring a steep ascent

evidence.supports: old tower access road no longer used but still evident
evidence.quote: no longer used, but still evident if you look

evidence.supports: limited views at the summit due to tree growth
evidence.quote: The trail offers limited views at the summit due to tree growth

evidence.supports: few other people likely on the route

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Eastern U.S. Lookouts page gives Bath County; the Forest Fire Lookout Association lists Bath and Augusta counties. The story names Bath County and reports the association's second county.

sources.title: Wallace Peak via Marshall Draft Trail

notes_for_editor: No build, staffing or removal dates appear in the sources read. The record's coordinates (38.15265, -79.53195) were not checked against another source. Access 'public' is inferred from a national forest hiking route described by a trail guide; confirm with the George Washington and Jefferson National Forests before anyone visits.
